verification.wordpressHookOrder: Cached core WP::main resolves query and queried object before send_headers; canonical removal runs on wp before wp_head.

reviewedBehavior: Whole WordPress document site defaults to noindex until explicit store opt-in, while WordPress blog_public must still allow indexing.

Staging core sitemaps are disabled. Published internal tariffs/service pages/default post are excluded non-destructively; author/date/attachment routes and users/Woo taxonomy providers remain hidden after opt-in.
Canonical and UA/RU alternates use current page URLs, skip unpublished translations and escape URL/attribute values. RU homepage preserves lang=ru.
Basic security headers preserve existing explicit policies and introduce no HSTS/CSP requirements.
Native JOYRENT routes remove Woo assets; genuine Woo routes and transitive owner jQuery dependencies retain theirs.
Cards and detail dialogs reuse the same real 720 px bundled artwork. Custom thumbnail URLs and nonbundled image names remain authoritative.

Deferred story media reserves equal heights before and after fetch at desktop/mobile, and displays media without IntersectionObserver. The three font imports, responsive hero imagery and CTA behavior are preserved.
limits: Final new-version ZIPs were not generated by this reviewer. Root must verify JPEG/include members and CRC after its final build. Existing package filters retain .jpg and recursively copy includes.
Theme PHP assertions use isolated WordPress query/options stubs. Actual core escaping and header hook order were checked separately, but no real database or deployment was exercised.
Deferred browser scenarios use the local source server and block non-GET/HEAD requests. No production writes, build, commit or source edits.
